meta.sector_scheme_label: GICS (S&P Dow Jones Indices / MSCI) — from constituents list
meta.flow_definition: sign(close - prev_close) * close * volume, summed per sector (estimate)
meta.flow_definition_clv: CLV * close * volume, CLV = ((close-low)-(high-close))/(high-low); cmf20 = sum(CLV*vol)/sum(vol) over 20d; mfi14 = Money Flow Index 14d on sector-aggregated typical-price flows
meta.short_volume_source: FINRA Reg SHO daily consolidated NMS short sale volume (off-exchange only)
